verdictMeaning: No remaining demonstrated defect within the reviewed source and focused CPU contracts. This is not a successful real browser acquisition, ordinary play verification, or element-completion judgment.
blindComparison: Not a blind comparison: implementation source was used only for this acquisition-method review. No stranger preference or E-08/E-09 quality judgment is made. Eventual quality judges must receive actual CI-emitted material without implementation source, these fixtures, or this review.

checks.description: Original receiver/arguments/return/exception identity; actual UI methods plus Japanese localization under CPU DOM stubs; localized selection with authored-index baseline; optional mode; exact frozen bundle hash; English/Japanese lossless multichunk file/hash/base64; driver failure; five incomplete-capture controls; browser-error failure.

observations.statement: The two wrappers call the original once using apply(this,args), then record post-method UI text/ending DOM paragraphs, and return the original result. CPU identity and exception checks pass.
observations.limit: Preservation is established for valid current receiver/data shapes. Dialogue is normalized this.full and choices are localized UI arguments; this does not prove finished browser rendering, typewriter timing, audio, or visual obstruction. Ending paragraphs are post-method DOM text.

observations.statement: The driver still selects by position in the current filtered authored-language choice list and calls ui.onChoose(idx). The new event reads the corresponding localized UI choice text before that call. Baseline and instrumented selected positions match; this index is not the stable original node choice index ci.
observations.limit: Selections are made by the deterministic driver, not by a human input recording.

observations.statement: The final transcript retains raw driver execution separately from browserErrors, executionSucceeded, captureErrors, and captureSucceeded. Driver errors, injected browser errors, and five incomplete event cases produce non-success and process exit 1.
observations.limit: The ordinary per-path ok line describes the raw driver result; captureSucceeded and final process/report status govern acquisition eligibility. Basic nonempty/count predicates do not establish event identity, order, or full transcript completeness; the independent control demonstrated that a same-count unoffered choice can pass them. Startup/browser/serialization exceptions can terminate before producing a transcript; absence is not success.

observations.statement: The frozen bundle is cinderline.1.0.0.js, SHA-256 0b882946d88ea55bfa49a761f9774679bf221defbc6f81f2906ebb6c3464015b. The matching index names that file. Multiple matching bundles are rejected before launch.
observations.limit: This is a local file provenance check; actual CI output must carry its own exact SHA and be matched to its build.

observations.statement: Encoded payload bytes match the exact newline-terminated artifact bytes and metadata SHA for both English and Japanese; Japanese fixture includes a supplementary character, emoji, combining text and multiple chunks.
observations.limit: This verifies byte fidelity under the source protocol. It does not establish remote log retrieval success, and fixtures are not product comparison material.

observations.statement: The existing workflow builds production output and runs publish then deal with --transcript, preserving shots with an always upload step.
observations.limit: Actual CI has not run here. The sequential step can stop after a failed publish command, so deal must not be presumed captured after such a failure. Artifact upload can preserve failed or partial material; artifact presence alone is insufficient. This job does not run a Japanese story path.

scopeLimits: CPU-only: no local browser, server, mobile helper, CI launch, or actual game recording.

Driver teleports, grants gas immunity, applies forced hostile damage, finishes typewriter text, shortens the crisis countdown, forces Nessa visible, and accelerates progression. It does not verify ordinary-paced play, combat, movement, survival, conditional-ending integration or full narrative quality.
The new nonempty/count checks establish basic acquisition completeness, not every dialogue branch, every ending, temporal fidelity, or full narrative causality.
E-08 and E-09 remain not measured by this method review. Eventual assessors must use actual emitted game material, not implementation source or these CPU fixtures.

refutationDisposition.wordingCorrected: Filtered choice-list position is distinguished from stable ci. Nonempty/count checks are explicitly limited; detailed driver shortcuts remain outside ordinary-play claims.
refutationDisposition.harnessReplayCaution: The original cpu-contract.mjs is the recorded acquisition harness and has snapshot/setup side effects. The independent script uses only frozen material.
